introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: This Privacy Policy describes how International University of Central Asia (IUCA) ("we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, and shares your personal information when you use our service. We are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring transparency about our data practices.

accountInfo.title: Account Information
accountInfo.content: When you create an account, we collect the following information:

items.email: Email address (required for authentication and communication)
items.profilePhoto: Profile photo (optional, stored as image file up to 5MB)

authenticationData.title: Authentication Data
authenticationData.content: We use JWT (JSON Web Tokens) for authentication. Access tokens and refresh tokens are stored in your browser's local storage. If you sign in with Google OAuth, we receive and store your Google ID token and associated profile information (name and email).

usageData.title: Usage Information
usageData.content: We collect information about your account activity, including assigned roles, permissions, account status (active/inactive), account creation date, and last update timestamp. We do not use third-party analytics or behavior tracking tools.

items.provideServices: To provide, maintain, and improve our services
items.authentication: To authenticate your identity and manage your account sessions
items.communication: To send you service-related emails (email verification, password reset, account notifications)
items.improve: To understand how users interact with our service and improve user experience
items.security: To detect, prevent, and address security issues and fraudulent activity

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.content: We use the following third-party services that may collect and process your data:

google.title: Google OAuth 2.0
google.content: When you sign in with Google, we use Google's OAuth service. Google's privacy policy governs their collection and use of your data. We only receive your basic profile information (name, email, and profile picture) that you authorize Google to share with us.

dataStorage.title: Data Storage and Security
dataStorage.content: Your account data is stored securely in our database. We implement industry-standard security measures including password hashing, encrypted connections (HTTPS), and secure authentication tokens.

localStorage.title: Browser Local Storage
localStorage.content: We store the following data in your browser's local storage:

items.authTokens: Authentication tokens (access token and refresh token for session management)
items.language: Language preference (to remember your selected language)

security.title: Data Security
security.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. However, no method of transmission over the internet or electronic storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

items.access: Access and review your personal information in your profile settings
items.correction: Update or correct your full name and profile photo at any time
items.deletion: Request account deletion through the account settings (includes a grace period during which you can cancel)
items.withdraw: Withdraw consent for data processing by deleting your account
items.portability: Request a copy of your data (contact us at helpdesk@iuca.kg)

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.content: We retain your personal information for as long as your account is active. When you request account deletion, your account is scheduled for deletion with a grace period. After the grace period expires, all your personal data is permanently deleted from our systems. You may cancel the deletion during the grace period.

children.title: Children's Privacy
children.content: Our service is not intended for users under the age of 13 (or the minimum age in your jurisdiction). We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If we become aware that we have collected personal information from a child without parental consent, we will take steps to delete that information.

international.title: International Data Transfers
international.content: Your information may be transferred to and processed in countries other than your country of residence. These countries may have data protection laws that are different from the laws of your country. We ensure appropriate safeguards are in place to protect your information in accordance with this Privacy Policy.

changes.title: Changes to This Privacy Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any material changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the "Last Updated" date. Your continued use of the service after changes are posted constitutes your acceptance of the updated Privacy Policy.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us at helpdesk@iuca.kg or Kyrgyz Republic, Tokmok city, Shamsinskaya 2.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: Welcome to International University of Central Asia (IUCA). These Terms of Use ("Terms") govern your access to and use of our services. By accessing or using our service, you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree to these Terms, please do not use our service.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By creating an account or using our service, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms and our Privacy Policy. You also represent that you have the legal capacity to enter into these Terms.

registration.title: Account Registration
registration.content: To use certain features of our service, you must create an account by providing accurate, complete, and current information including your email address and full name. You may register using email and password, or through Google OAuth authentication. Email verification is required to activate your account.

security.title: Account Security
security.content: You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account and password. Your password must meet our security requirements:

items.passwordRequirements: Minimum 8 characters with at least one uppercase letter, lowercase letter, number, and special character (@$!%*?&#)
items.confidentiality: Keep your password confidential and do not share it with others
items.unauthorized: Notify us immediately of any unauthorized access to your account
items.liability: You are responsible for all activities that occur under your account

emailVerification.title: Email Verification
emailVerification.content: You must verify your email address by clicking the confirmation link sent to your email. Unverified accounts may have limited functionality. You may request to resend the verification email if needed.

responsibilities.title: User Responsibilities
responsibilities.intro: When using our service, you agree to:

items.accurate: Provide accurate, current, and complete information
items.lawful: Use the service only for lawful purposes and in compliance with all applicable laws
items.noHarm: Not attempt to interfere with, compromise, or disrupt the service or servers
items.noImpersonation: Not impersonate any person or entity or falsely represent your affiliation
items.noUnauthorized: Not attempt to gain unauthorized access to any part of the service
items.respectRights: Respect the intellectual property rights of others

authentication.title: Authentication and Sessions
authentication.content: Our service uses JWT (JSON Web Token) authentication to manage user sessions. When you log in, you receive an access token and a refresh token.

tokens.title: Session Tokens
tokens.content: Access tokens are short-lived and automatically refresh. Refresh tokens are stored in your browser's local storage. You may choose "Remember Me" during login to maintain your session across browser restarts. You are responsible for logging out on shared devices.

oauth.title: Google OAuth
oauth.content: If you sign in with Google, you agree to Google's Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. We receive only the information you authorize Google to share with us. You may set a password later to enable traditional email/password login in addition to Google authentication.

uploads.title: File Uploads and Content
uploads.content: You may upload a profile photo to personalize your account. By uploading content, you represent that:

items.fileTypes: Files must be in JPEG, PNG, or WebP format
items.appropriate: Content is appropriate and does not violate any laws or third-party rights
items.rights: You have the necessary rights to upload and share the content

rolesPermissions.title: Roles and Permissions
rolesPermissions.content: Your account may be assigned one or more roles by administrators. Roles determine your permissions and access levels within the service. We reserve the right to modify, assign, or remove roles at our discretion. You may not attempt to access features or data beyond your assigned permissions.

byUser.title: Termination by You
byUser.content: You may request account deletion at any time through your account settings. When you request deletion, your account will be scheduled for deletion after a grace period. During the grace period, you may cancel the deletion request. After the grace period expires, your account and all associated data will be permanently deleted.

byUs.title: Termination by Us
byUs.content: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your account at any time, with or without notice, for violating these Terms, engaging in fraudulent activity, or for any other reason at our sole discretion. We may also disable accounts that remain inactive for extended periods.

intellectualProperty.title: Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.content: The service and its original content, features, and functionality are owned by International University of Central Asia (IUCA) and are protected by international copyright, trademark, and other intellectual property laws. You may not copy, modify, distribute, sell, or lease any part of our service without our express written permission.

disclaimers.title: Disclaimers
disclaimers.asIs: The service is provided "as is" and "as available" without warranties of any kind.
disclaimers.content: We do not guarantee that the service will be uninterrupted, secure, or error-free. We disclaim all warranties, express or implied, including warranties of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, and non-infringement. Your use of the service is at your own risk.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.content: To the maximum extent permitted by law, International University of Central Asia (IUCA) shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, or any loss of profits or revenues, whether direct or indirect, or any loss of data, use, goodwill, or other intangible losses resulting from your use of or inability to use the service.

modifications.title: Modifications to Terms
modifications.content: We reserve the right to modify these Terms at any time. We will notify you of material changes by posting the updated Terms on this page and updating the "Last Updated" date. Your continued use of the service after changes are posted constitutes your acceptance of the modified Terms.

governingLaw.title: Governing Law and Disputes
governingLaw.content: These Terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Kyrgyz Republic, without regard to its conflict of law provisions. Any disputes arising from these Terms or your use of the service shall be resolved in the courts of Kyrgyz Republic.
